claims.statement: A selected candidate source points to the UCI Machine Learning Repository Iris dataset page at https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/iris.
No extracted source content was available to verify Iris dataset sample sizes, variable names, species labels, missing-data status, or sepal-length/petal-length correlations.
The available selected source evidence is insufficient to determine whether sepal length and petal length have a stable linear association in the public Iris dataset overall.
The available selected source evidence is insufficient to determine whether the sepal-length/petal-length linear association differs among setosa, versicolor, and virginica.

Any answer about the Iris dataset would require direct computation on a clearly identified dataset version or extraction of reported statistics from a verified source; neither was available in the provided evidence.
